compiled_receipt_consistency.execution_by_this_reviewer: No duplicate Lean run; inspected the current gate receipt and verified its input hashes, inventories, counts and dependencies. Root separately clean-compiled this candidate.

semantic_checks.reason: decodeHistorical is explicitly pinned to the pre-repair commit and is not presented as current behavior. Both normal outcomes encode 200, so arbitrary normal NoOp loses its required Applied fields. The concrete due witness satisfies the current classifier without malformed state.

decodeTyped uses the persisted business discriminator. typed_roundtrip proves every normally encoded Applied/NoOp survives. The structured Body abstracts parsed JSON and does not claim missing/wrong-typed JSON parsing is proved.

Resolved is an explicit implementation-correspondence premise, not an invented runtime guard. It does not require target visit to be current, so stale visit/closed/version-mismatch cases remain in classify. appliedState preserves that binding.

resolved_future_witness_is_applicable constructs a resolved, active future-eligible state, matching version and non-overflowing counter. It is not a proof of a production SCHEDULER_DEFER writer; that limitation is explicit.

Fresh apply increments version, business Event count and eligibility fact count together; NoOp only records a receipt in this module. record_stores_original_outcome establishes the stored premise used by arbitrary-count induction. Replay theorems do not assume the target no-duplicate property directly.

invalid_cause payload deliberately omits detail. The information-loss theorem and missing-context negative theorem expose this. ContextMatches requires the original cause to be hash-bound; completed_outcome_roundtrip is correctly conditional and the actual unchanged JCS envelope covers cause. Hash correctness is not proved.

stageRejection records the same scope/hash and exactly one rejection audit while preserving business/activation. Freshness is required for runRejection first-write theorems. The count is explicitly only WAKE_REJECTED, so conflict/applied/no-op audit mutations are not silently included.

settle explicitly chooses full staged state or prestate. Atomic commit/rollback semantics are modeled assumptions, not derived PostgreSQL facts. Acknowledged durability is proved only for the constructed rejection write set; arbitrary staged data is not certified as an actual valid Rust transaction.

unknownCommitted and unknownRolledBack are world alternatives, both observed as unavailable. unknown_apply_can_hide_either_business_result uses a nonempty valid apply witness and distinguishes version 2 from version 1. It does not infer zero effects from an infrastructure error.

semantic_checks.area: Read replay failure and arbitrary finite traces
semantic_checks.reason: observeRead permits unavailable even with an already durable completed receipt. retryTrace induction allows arbitrary fresh rejection parameters and resolutions, preserving modeled database state and returning only original outcome or unavailable. Existing receipt selection makes freshReason irrelevant; it is not a hidden reclassification assumption.

Processing is never decoded as completed. Other command types/different hashes conflict. Codec status/code mismatches fail. Exact SQL error timing and unmodeled audit categories remain implementation obligations.

README distinguishes conditional model proof, source mapping, executable tests and production acceptance. It does not claim fairness, liveness, every retry response succeeds, whole-program refinement, arbitrary external mutations during a trace, or production deployment.

remaining_obligations: Atomic serialized execution, SQLx/PostgreSQL semantics, lock/unique-constraint behavior and crash recovery require separate implementation evidence.
These are two linked abstract slices, not a fully composed executable proof of every Wake HTTP, auth, parsing, storage and network path.
Fresh rejection classification and hash/cause equality must be established by the actual caller; runRejection accepts an externally supplied classified reason.
Rejection-only audit counts do not prove Applied/NoOp/conflict audit behavior; root regression evidence and prior independent Rust source review cover those separately.
A returned unavailable can hide business changes for apply; real lost-acknowledgement injection has not been claimed by this model review.
Source review and gate receipt do not establish production SCHEDULER_DEFER reachability, fairness or original business task completion.
Parent authority recovery remains separate; no canonical authority restoration or full-repository conformance is inferred.
